policy: No full factorial by default; no performance-driven retries; do not block H1 on expansion failure
batch_gate: Non-null actual caps and measured pilot cost required before corresponding batch; limited pilot must separately fit available allocation

MD.metadynamics_gate: pre-register time, number of replicas, convergence criteria and separate resource cap before use; no indefinite extension

freeze_before_batch: observed conformer time and peak storage
degradation_priority: P1 graph baseline and H2/H3 matched factorial where feasible
P1 core source/FP06 sensitivity and endpoint replication where compatible
P2 high-quality ensembles and matched MD
P3 optional models and explanatory controls
on_exhaustion: Stop affected optional block, save pending/failure status and rationale; never borrow holdout data; change P01 only by capacity rules before performance.
